summary.text: Kim Ferguson is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 1st Worcester District, which includes Holden, Paxton, Princeton, Rutland and Westminster, first elected in November 2010.
Her official biography says she has been Assistant Minority Leader since November 2021.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly N. Ferguson's official biography says she holds a Master of Science in speech/language pathology and a Certificate of Advanced Graduate Study in education leadership and management.
It says she worked as a private-practice speech/language pathologist and consultant before being elected.
Before the House, she served on the Wachusett Regional School District Committee and then on the Holden Board of Selectmen for eight years.
The biography says she recently completed ten years as Ranking Member of the Joint Committee on Education and played a key role in passing the Student Opportunity Act.
The Legislature's committee listing shows her as ranking minority member of the House Committee on Bills in the Third Reading.

The biography says she concluded ten years as a State Director for Women in Government, is a member of the Massachusetts Caucus of Women Legislators, and has co-chaired the Massachusetts Brain Injury Commission.
